create_subclass_of_AbstractDataset: create a subclass of AbstractDataset that implements _download_and_process_raw to load recommendation data
implement_download_and_process_raw: implement the _download_and_process_raw method in a subclass to download and process raw item sequence data
split_dataset_leave_one_out: split the dataset into train, validation, and test sets using the leave_one_out strategy via the split method
get_dataset_statistics: get the number of users, items, interactions, and average sequence length using the n_users, n_items, n_interactions, and avg_item_seq_len properties
access_id_mappings: access the user2id and item2id mappings to convert user and item identifiers to integer IDs
